name: Evidence-gate defect corpus
detail: The measured half runs the real argus.core.contracts / argus.adapters.published_mesh geometry code -- not a lookalike -- against real tifxyz meshes and a real local zarr store: mesh-outside-volume (#1660), a discontinuous seam (#1675), and a chunk store whose data was never written (#1674) all fail as expected; a clean control passes every gate.
